# VISFURN

VISFURN provides custom wooden, WPC and security door systems for international B2B residential, hospitality, commercial, healthcare and education projects.

## What VISFURN helps buyers decide
VISFURN is relevant when a buyer needs a project door supplier to review a door schedule, coordinate door leaves with frames and hardware, compare material options, prepare samples, organize export packing or plan a quotation by quantity and destination.
- Best fit: contractors, developers, hotel procurement teams, hospital and school project buyers, door importers and building-material distributors.
- Typical input: door schedule or drawings, opening IDs, quantities, leaf and rough-opening sizes, finished wall thickness, handing, frame, finish, hardware template, performance notes and destination port.
- Typical output: a specification-based quotation route, clarification list, coordinated door-set proposal, sample discussion and project packing or delivery plan.
- Do not infer a certification from a product name alone. Fire, acoustic, security and market requirements must be confirmed for the exact door-set configuration and project authority.

## RFQ
- https://www.visfurn.com/contact#quote-form — Send sizes, quantities, specifications and destination for project quotation.
- For the fastest review, send the original Excel door schedule or drawings instead of only a product name.
- For hotel projects, include room type, opening mark, fire or acoustic note, electronic-lock template, finish reference and packing sequence.
- For WPC or humid-area projects, include wet-area exposure, threshold, tile transition, frame depth and hardware requirements.
- For fire or security doors, include the required standard or approving authority and request review of the complete assembly evidence.
- https://www.visfurn.com/faq — Buyer FAQ.
- https://www.visfurn.com/sitemap.xml — Complete current URL inventory.

- https://www.visfurn.com/case-study/iraq-residential-rebuild-glazed-double-swing-doors — Representative Iraq residential rebuild case covering glazed double swing doors, opening measurements, schedules and hardware coordination.
